Prompt Injection and Jailbreaking.name: Prompt Injection and Jailbreaking
Prompt Injection and Jailbreaking.description: Prompts that attempt to bypass LLM safety protocols. This category uses on/off control instead of threshold levels.

Inappropriate Content.name: Hate Speech and Discrimination
Inappropriate Content.description: Content that promotes hatred, prejudice, or discrimination based on protected characteristics.

Inappropriate Content.name: Crimes
Inappropriate Content.description: Content that promotes, encourages, or provides guidance on committing unlawful acts.

Inappropriate Content.name: Weapons
Inappropriate Content.description: Content that involves the creation, use, or promotion of harmful or dangerous devices designed to cause significant injury or destruction.

Inappropriate Content.name: Suicide and Self-Harm
Inappropriate Content.description: Content that promotes, encourages, or discusses self-harm behaviors or suicide.

Inappropriate Content.name: Sex-Related Crimes and Content
Inappropriate Content.description: Content that promotes or depicts illegal and harmful sexual activities, including sex trafficking, prostitution, sexual assault, harassment, and child sexual exploitation.

Inappropriate Content.name: Requests for Sensitive Data
Inappropriate Content.description: Requests that aim to illegally obtain, extract, or reveal sensitive personal information about real individuals without their consent.

Inappropriate Content.name: Piracy and Copyright
Inappropriate Content.description: Prompts or responses that attempt to retrieve, leak, or discuss the acquisition of copyrighted materials without authorization.
